The '''Impossible Sector''' was a region of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that included a notoriously dangerous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] route. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Imperial-allied [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] erected a minefield in the Impossible Sector, blocking Republic-commissioned smuggler traffic.
